name: excalivibe
description: Vibe Working capability suite — authored once under src/, compiled to Claude plugins, Codex plugins and the vendor-neutral .agents/ layout.

plugins.name: computer-use
plugins.description: How to operate a computer — the capabilities an agent needs to reach past its own text output and act on a real machine. Currently browser control with automatic framework selection and degradation, rich human-readable document artifacts with a local preview, and out-of-band notifications that reach the user when the terminal cannot.

plugins.name: dev-toolkit
plugins.description: Atomic development skills — engineering conventions, working methods, and check-and-verdict passes. Each one stands alone, triggers on its own subject matter, and assumes nothing about who invoked it, so they compose freely rather than only inside a pipeline.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Development pipeline roles and the flow that wires them — subagents each with a single responsibility, plus the step definitions an external graph engine schedules them from. The engine is a separate package; what ships here is the flow, not the runtime.
